title.en: Nanny: from listing to the families who can find you
title.af: Kinderoppasser: van advertensie tot die gesinne wat jou kan vind
title.zu: Umzanyana: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya emindenini engakuthola
title.xh: Umgcini-bantwana: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kwiintsapho ezinokukufumana
title.nso: Mohlokomedi wa bana: go tloga papatšong go ya go malapa ao a ka go hwetšago

gate_note.en: Coming up at step 12: until our team has checked your police clearance, only people you send your link to can see your listing.
gate_note.af: By stap 12: totdat ons span jou polisieklaring nagegaan het, kan net mense aan wie jy jou skakel stuur jou advertensie sien.
gate_note.zu: Kuyeza esinyathelweni 12: kuze kube yilapho ithimba lethu selihlolile isitifiketi sakho samaphoyisa, ngabantu kuphela obathumelela isixhumanisi sakho abangabona isikhangiso sakho.
gate_note.xh: Kwinyathelo le-12: de iqela lethu lihlole isatifikethi sakho samapolisa, ngabantu kuphela obathumelela ikhonkco lakho abanokubona intengiso yakho.
gate_note.nso: Kgatong ya 12: go fihlela sehlopha sa rena se hlahlobile setifikeiti sa gago sa maphodisa, ke batho feela bao o ba romelago kgokagano ya gago bao ba ka bonago papatšo ya gago.

chapters.af: Die gesinne vir wie jy werk

en: Open Quick, tap [[Offer a service]]
Quick opens on the services door. One tap starts your listing.
af: Maak Quick oop, tik [[Offer a service]]
Quick maak oop by die dienste-deur. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, thepha [[Offer a service]]
I-Quick ivula emnyango wezinsizakalo. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, cofa [[Offer a service]]
I-Quick ivula kucango leenkonzo. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, kgotla [[Offer a service]]
Quick e bula lebating la ditirelo. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Pick [[Home & care]], then [[Nanny]]
Choose the kind of work, then your job. Caregivers, au pairs and crèche assistants follow the same steps.
af: Kies [[Home & care]], dan [[Nanny]]
Kies die soort werk, dan jou werk. Versorgers, au pairs en crèche-assistente volg dieselfde stappe.
zu: Khetha [[Home & care]], bese [[Nanny]]
Khetha uhlobo lomsebenzi, bese kuba umsebenzi wakho. Abanakekeli, ama-au pair nabasizi basenkulisa balandela izinyathelo ezifanayo.
xh: Khetha [[Home & care]], emva koko [[Nanny]]
Khetha uhlobo lomsebenzi, emva koko umsebenzi wakho. Abakhathaleli, ii-au pair nabancedisi bekhreshi balandela amanyathelo afanayo.
nso: Kgetha [[Home & care]], ke moka [[Nanny]]
Kgetha mohuta wa mošomo, ke moka mošomo wa gago. Bahlokomedi, di-au pair le bathuši ba krešhe ba latela dikgato tše di swanago.

en: Tick every area you work in
You can tick more than one, and a family searching any of them finds you. Type your area if it is not listed.
af: Merk elke area waar jy werk
Jy kan meer as een merk, en 'n gesin wat in enige van hulle soek, vind jou. Tik jou area in as dit nie gelys is nie.
zu: Maka zonke izindawo osebenza kuzo
Ungamaka ezingaphezu kweyodwa, futhi umndeni osesha kunoma iyiphi yazo uyakuthola. Bhala indawo yakho uma ingekho ohlwini.
xh: Phawula yonke imimandla osebenza kuyo
Ungaphawula engaphezu komnye, kwaye usapho olukhangela kuyo nayiphi na luyakufumana. Bhala indawo yakho ukuba ayikho kuluhlu.
nso: Swaya mafelo ka moka ao o šomago go ona
O ka swaya a fetago le tee, gomme lapa le le nyakago go le ge e le lefe la ona le a go hwetša. Ngwala lefelo la gago ge le se lenaneong.

en: Choose your days
Tap the days you can work.
af: Kies jou dae
Tik die dae waarop jy kan werk.
zu: Khetha izinsuku zakho
Thepha izinsuku ongasebenza ngazo.
xh: Khetha iintsuku zakho
Cofa iintsuku onokusebenza ngazo.
nso: Kgetha matšatši a gago
Kgotla matšatši ao o ka šomago ka ona.

en: Set your day rate
Type what your work is worth. Quick shows the legal minimum wage, so nobody can pay you less.
af: Stel jou dagtarief
Tik wat jou werk werd is. Quick wys die wettige minimum loon, sodat niemand jou minder kan betaal nie.
zu: Beka imali yakho yosuku
Bhala ukuthi umsebenzi wakho ubiza malini. I-Quick ikhombisa iholo elincane elisemthethweni, ukuze kungabikho muntu okukhokhela ngaphansi.
xh: Beka ixabiso lakho losuku
Bhala ukuba umsebenzi wakho uxabisa malini. I-Quick ibonisa owona mvuzo uphantsi osemthethweni, ukuze kungabikho mntu ukuhlawula ngaphantsi.
nso: Bea tefo ya gago ya letšatši
Ngwala seo mošomo wa gago o se swanetšego. Quick e bontšha moputso wa fase wa molao, gore go se be le yo a go lefago ka fase ga wona.

en: Tick the ages you care for
[[Babies]], [[Toddlers]], [[School age]] or [[Teenagers]]. Families see them on your listing.
af: Merk die ouderdomme wat jy oppas
[[Babies]], [[Toddlers]], [[School age]] of [[Teenagers]]. Gesinne sien dit op jou advertensie.
zu: Maka iminyaka yezingane ozinakekelayo
[[Babies]], [[Toddlers]], [[School age]] noma [[Teenagers]]. Imindeni iyibona esikhangisweni sakho.
xh: Phawula iminyaka yabantwana obakhathalelayo
[[Babies]], [[Toddlers]], [[School age]] okanye [[Teenagers]]. Iintsapho ziyibona kwintengiso yakho.
nso: Swaya mengwaga ya bana bao o ba hlokomelago
[[Babies]], [[Toddlers]], [[School age]] goba [[Teenagers]]. Malapa a e bona papatšong ya gago.

en: Note the police clearance, add your first name and email, then save
Quick tells you now: families find a nanny only once her police clearance is checked. Tap [[Save my listing]]. No password.
af: Let op die polisieklaring, voeg jou voornaam en e-pos by, en stoor
Quick sê dit nou reeds: gesinne vind 'n kinderoppasser eers sodra haar polisieklaring nagegaan is. Tik [[Save my listing]]. Geen wagwoord nie.
zu: Qaphela isitifiketi samaphoyisa, faka igama lakho lokuqala ne-imeyili, bese ulondoloza
I-Quick ikutshela manje: imindeni ithola umzanyana kuphela uma isitifiketi sakhe samaphoyisa sesihloliwe. Thepha [[Save my listing]]. Ayikho iphasiwedi.
xh: Qaphela isatifikethi samapolisa, faka igama lakho lokuqala ne-imeyile, uze ugcine
I-Quick ikuxelela ngoku: iintsapho zifumana umgcini-bantwana kuphela xa isatifikethi sakhe samapolisa sele sihloliwe. Cofa [[Save my listing]]. Akukho phasiwedi.
nso: Ela hloko setifikeiti sa maphodisa, tsenya leina la gago la pele le imeile, ke moka o boloke
Quick e go botša bjale: malapa a hwetša mohlokomedi wa bana fela ge setifikeiti sa gagwe sa maphodisa se šetše se hlahlobilwe. Kgotla [[Save my listing]]. Ga go na phasewete.

en: Saved: now sign the terms and publish
Tap [[Sign the terms and publish]], or open the email we sent you. Nobody can see your listing yet.
af: Gestoor: teken nou die bepalings en publiseer
Tik [[Sign the terms and publish]], of maak die e-pos oop wat ons gestuur het. Niemand kan jou advertensie nog sien nie.
zu: Kulondoloziwe: manje sayina imigomo bese ushicilela
Thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]], noma uvule i-imeyili esikuthumelele yona. Akekho umuntu ongabona isikhangiso sakho okwamanje.
xh: Kugciniwe: ngoku sayina imimiselo uze upapashe
Cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]], okanye uvule i-imeyile esikuthumelele yona. Akukho mntu unokubona intengiso yakho okwangoku.
nso: E bolokilwe: bjale saena melawana gomme o phatlalatše
Kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]], goba o bule imeile ye re go rometšego yona. Ga go yo a ka bonago papatšo ya gago ga bjale.

en: Add your own photo
In TrustSquare tap [[Edit]], then [[Add Photo]]: a photo of your work with no children's faces and no writing on it. Tap [[Save Changes]].
af: Voeg jou eie foto by
Tik in TrustSquare [[Edit]], dan [[Add Photo]]: 'n foto van jou werk sonder kindergesiggies en sonder skrif daarop. Tik [[Save Changes]].
zu: Faka isithombe sakho
Ku-TrustSquare thepha [[Edit]], bese [[Add Photo]]: isithombe somsebenzi wakho esingenabo ubuso bezingane futhi esingenambhalo. Thepha [[Save Changes]].
xh: Faka owakho umfanekiso
Kwi-TrustSquare cofa [[Edit]], emva koko [[Add Photo]]: umfanekiso womsebenzi wakho ongenabo ubuso babantwana kwaye ongenambhalo. Cofa [[Save Changes]].
nso: Tsenya seswantšho sa gago
Go TrustSquare kgotla [[Edit]], ke moka [[Add Photo]]: seswantšho sa mošomo wa gago se se se nago difahlego tša bana le mangwalo. Kgotla [[Save Changes]].

en: Accept the seller terms once
Read them, tick both boxes at the end and tap [[I accept]].
af: Aanvaar die verkopersbepalings een keer
Lees hulle, merk albei blokkies aan die einde en tik [[I accept]].
zu: Yamukela imigomo yabathengisi kanye
Yifunde, maka omabili amabhokisi ekugcineni bese uthepha [[I accept]].
xh: Yamkela imimiselo yabathengisi kanye
Yifunde, phawula zombini iibhokisi ekugqibeleni uze ucofe [[I accept]].
nso: Amogela melawana ya barekiši gatee
E bale, swaya mapokisi a mabedi mafelelong gomme o kgotle [[I accept]].

en: Publish
Tap [[Publish]]. Your listing is live, but for now only people you send your link to can see it. Your card says why: families see it once our team has checked your police clearance.
af: Publiseer
Tik [[Publish]]. Jou advertensie is aanlyn, maar vir eers kan net mense aan wie jy jou skakel stuur dit sien. Jou kaart sê hoekom: gesinne sien dit sodra ons span jou polisieklaring nagegaan het.
zu: Shicilela

Thepha [[Publish]]. Isikhangiso sakho sesiphilayo, kodwa okwamanje ngabantu kuphela obathumelela isixhumanisi sakho abangasibona. Ikhadi lakho lichaza isizathu: imindeni iyasibona uma ithimba lethu selihlolile isitifiketi sakho samaphoyisa.
xh: Papasha

Cofa [[Publish]]. Intengiso yakho iphilile, kodwa okwangoku ngabantu kuphela obathumelela ikhonkco lakho abanokuyibona. Ikhadi lakho lichaza isizathu: iintsapho ziyayibona xa iqela lethu sele lihlolile isatifikethi sakho samapolisa.
nso: Phatlalatša

Kgotla [[Publish]]. Papatšo ya gago e phela, eupša ga bjale ke batho feela bao o ba romelago kgokagano ya gago bao ba ka e bonago. Karata ya gago e hlaloša lebaka: malapa a e bona ge sehlopha sa rena se šetše se hlahlobile setifikeiti sa gago sa maphodisa.

en: Tap [[Upload my police clearance]]
It opens the right upload with [[Police clearance]] already chosen. Tap [[Choose file]], pick a clear photo or PDF of your SAPS clearance and tap [[Upload Document]].
af: Tik [[Upload my police clearance]]
Dit maak die regte oplaai oop met [[Police clearance]] reeds gekies. Tik [[Choose file]], kies 'n duidelike foto of PDF van jou SAPD-klaring en tik [[Upload Document]].
zu: Thepha [[Upload my police clearance]]
Ivula indawo efanele yokulayisha, i-[[Police clearance]] isivele ikhethiwe. Thepha [[Choose file]], khetha isithombe esicacile noma i-PDF yesitifiketi sakho se-SAPS bese uthepha [[Upload Document]].
xh: Cofa [[Upload my police clearance]]

Ivula indawo efanelekileyo yokulayisha, i-[[Police clearance]] sele ikhethiwe. Cofa [[Choose file]], khetha umfanekiso ocacileyo okanye i-PDF yesatifikethi sakho se-SAPS uze ucofe [[Upload Document]].
nso: Kgotla [[Upload my police clearance]]

E bula lefelo le le nepagetšego la go romela, [[Police clearance]] e šetše e kgethilwe. Kgotla [[Choose file]], kgetha seswantšho se se kwagalago goba PDF ya setifikeiti sa gago sa SAPS gomme o kgotle [[Upload Document]].

en: It goes to our team
The app says so: a person checks it, then your points are added and strangers can see your listing. A clearance nobody has looked at never opens it.
af: Dit gaan na ons span
Die app sê so: 'n mens gaan dit na, dan word jou punte bygetel en kan vreemdelinge jou advertensie sien. 'n Klaring waarna niemand gekyk het nie, maak dit nooit oop nie.
zu: Iya ethimbeni lethu
Uhlelo lokusebenza lusho kanjalo: umuntu uyasihlola, bese amaphuzu akho engezwa futhi abantu ongabazi bangasibona isikhangiso sakho. Isitifiketi esingakabhekwa muntu asisivuli neze.
xh: Iya kwiqela lethu
Usetyenziso luyatsho: umntu uyasihlola, emva koko amanqaku akho ayongezwa kwaye abantu ongabaziyo banokuyibona intengiso yakho. Isatifikethi ekungekho mntu usijongileyo asiyivuli.
nso: Se ya go sehlopha sa rena

Tirišo e bolela bjalo: motho o a se hlahloba, ke moka dintlha tša gago di a oketšwa gomme batho bao o sa ba tsebego ba ka bona papatšo ya gago. Setifikeiti se go se nago motho yo a se lebeletšego ga se e bule.

en: Your card shows it is waiting
Back in your Seller Hub: [[Your police clearance is with our team]]. Until then your listing stays out of searches, which keeps the children and people you care for safe.
af: Jou kaart wys dit wag
Terug in jou Seller Hub: [[Your police clearance is with our team]]. Tot dan bly jou advertensie uit soektogte, wat die kinders en mense vir wie jy sorg veilig hou.
zu: Ikhadi lakho likhombisa ukuthi kulindiwe
Emuva ku-Seller Hub yakho: [[Your police clearance is with our team]]. Kuze kube yilapho isikhangiso sakho asiveli ekuseshweni, okugcina izingane nabantu obanakekelayo bephephile.
xh: Ikhadi lakho libonisa ukuba kusalindwe
Emva kwi-Seller Hub yakho: [[Your police clearance is with our team]]. De kube ngoko intengiso yakho ayiveli ekukhangeleni, nto leyo egcina abantwana nabantu obakhathalelayo bekhuselekile.
nso: Karata ya gago e bontšha gore go sa letilwe

Morago go Seller Hub ya gago: [[Your police clearance is with our team]]. Go fihlela ka nako yeo papatšo ya gago ga e tšwelele dinyakišišong, e lego seo se bolokago bana le batho bao o ba hlokomelago ba šireletšegile.

en: Our team checks it: families can find you
Once it is checked, your listing shows in searches and your Trust Score goes up.
af: Ons span gaan dit na: gesinne kan jou vind
Sodra dit nagegaan is, verskyn jou advertensie in soektogte en jou Trust Score gaan op.
zu: Ithimba lethu liyasihlola: imindeni ingakuthola
Uma sesihloliwe, isikhangiso sakho siyavela ekuseshweni futhi i-Trust Score yakho iyenyuka.
xh: Iqela lethu liyasihlola: iintsapho zinokukufumana
Xa sele sihloliwe, intengiso yakho iyavela ekukhangeleni kwaye i-Trust Score yakho iyanyuka.
nso: Sehlopha sa rena se a se hlahloba: malapa a ka go hwetša
Ge se šetše se hlahlobilwe, papatšo ya gago e a tšwelela dinyakišišong gomme Trust Score ya gago e a godišwa.

en: Send your Buzz link to the families you work for
In [[My Space]], open [[Buzz]] and tap [[Get my link]]. One link for all of them: [[Send on WhatsApp]] or [[Copy]].
af: Stuur jou Buzz-skakel aan die gesinne vir wie jy werk
Maak in [[My Space]] [[Buzz]] oop en tik [[Get my link]]. Een skakel vir almal: [[Send on WhatsApp]] of [[Copy]].
zu: Thumela isixhumanisi sakho se-Buzz emindenini oyisebenzelayo
Ku-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]] bese uthepha [[Get my link]]. Isixhumanisi esisodwa sabo bonke: [[Send on WhatsApp]] noma [[Copy]].
xh: Thumela ikhonkco lakho le-Buzz kwiintsapho ozisebenzelayo
Kwi-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]] uze ucofe [[Get my link]]. Ikhonkco elinye labo bonke: [[Send on WhatsApp]] okanye [[Copy]].
nso: Romela kgokagano ya gago ya Buzz go malapa ao o a šomelago
Go [[My Space]], bula [[Buzz]] gomme o kgotle [[Get my link]]. Kgokagano e tee ya bohle: [[Send on WhatsApp]] goba [[Copy]].

en: A family you work for joins
She taps the link, ticks the Buzz terms and taps [[Continue]]. You are connected, and it costs nothing.
af: 'n Gesin vir wie jy werk, sluit aan
Sy tik die skakel, merk die Buzz-bepalings en tik [[Continue]]. Julle is verbind, en dit kos niks.
zu: Umndeni owusebenzelayo uyajoyina
Uthepha isixhumanisi, amake imigomo ye-Buzz bese ethepha [[Continue]]. Nixhumene, futhi akubizi lutho.
xh: Usapho olusebenzelayo luyajoyina
Ucofa ikhonkco, aphawule imimiselo ye-Buzz aze acofe [[Continue]]. Nidibene, kwaye akubizi nto.
nso: Lapa leo o le šomelago le a tsena
O kgotla kgokagano, a swaya melawana ya Buzz gomme a kgotla [[Continue]]. Le kopane, gomme ga go bitše selo.

en: She buzzes you
One line, straight to your phone, with her name on it: 'Can you also come on Saturday morning?'
af: Sy buzz jou
Een reël, reguit na jou foon, met haar naam daarop: 'Kan jy Saterdagoggend ook kom?'
zu: Uyakubuzza
Umugqa owodwa, uqonde efonini yakho, unegama lakhe: 'Ungafika nangoMgqibelo ekuseni?'
xh: Uyakubuzza
Umgca omnye, uthe ngqo kwifowuni yakho, unegama lakhe: 'Ungeza nangoMgqibelo kusasa?'
nso: O go buzza
Mothalo o tee, thwii go founo ya gago, o na le leina la gagwe: 'O ka tla le ka Mokibelo mesong?'

en: A new family finds you
She finds you under [[Services]] by area, and sees your rate, your days, the ages you care for and your Trust Score.
af: 'n Nuwe gesin vind jou
Sy vind jou onder [[Services]] volgens area, en sien jou tarief, jou dae, die ouderdomme wat jy oppas en jou Trust Score.
zu: Umndeni omusha uyakuthola
Ukuthola ngaphansi kwe-[[Services]] ngendawo, abone imali yakho, izinsuku zakho, iminyaka yezingane ozinakekelayo ne-Trust Score yakho.
xh: Usapho olutsha luyakufumana
Ukufumana phantsi kwe-[[Services]] ngendawo, abone ixabiso lakho, iintsuku zakho, iminyaka yabantwana obakhathalelayo ne-Trust Score yakho.
nso: Lapa le leswa le a go hwetša
O go hwetša ka fase ga [[Services]] ka lefelo, a bona tefo ya gago, matšatši a gago, mengwaga ya bana bao o ba hlokomelago le Trust Score ya gago.

en: She asks for an introduction
She writes a short message. 1 Tuppence is held from her, and spent only if you accept.
af: Sy vra vir 'n voorstelling
Sy skryf 'n kort boodskap. 1 Tuppence word van haar teruggehou, en net bestee as jy aanvaar.
zu: Ucela ukwethulwa
Ubhala umlayezo omfushane. I-Tuppence engu-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetshenziswe kuphela uma wamukela.
xh: Ucela ukwaziswa
Ubhala umyalezo omfutshane. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetyenziswe kuphela ukuba uyamkela.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O ngwala molaetša o mokopana. Tuppence e 1 e a swarwa go yena, e šomišwa fela ge o amogela.

en: You accept
Open [[My Space]], then [[Intros]], and tap [[Accept]]. You both get an email: reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Jy aanvaar
Maak [[My Space]] oop, dan [[Intros]], en tik [[Accept]]. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos: antwoord dit om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Uyamukela
Vula i-[[My Space]], bese [[Intros]], bese uthepha [[Accept]]. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili: yiphendule ukuze nixoxe. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Uyamkela
Vula i-[[My Space]], emva koko [[Intros]], uze ucofe [[Accept]]. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile: yiphendule ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: O a amogela
Bula [[My Space]], ke moka [[Intros]], gomme o kgotle [[Accept]]. Le fela le hwetša imeile: e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: Pass Quick on
Tap [[Pass Quick on to someone]] and share it with a friend who works like you.
af: Gee Quick aan
Tik [[Pass Quick on to someone]] en deel dit met 'n vriendin wat werk soos jy.
zu: Dlulisela i-Quick
Thepha [[Pass Quick on to someone]] bese uyabelana ngayo nomngane osebenza njengawe.
xh: Dlulisela i-Quick
Cofa [[Pass Quick on to someone]] uze wabelane ngayo nomhlobo osebenza njengawe.
nso: Fetišetša Quick pele
Kgotla [[Pass Quick on to someone]] gomme o e abelane le mogwera yo a šomago bjalo ka wena.
